summary: Immutep Ltd filed a Form 6-K containing its quarterly activities report (Appendix 4C) for Q4 FY26. The filing covers routine clinical trial updates (eftilagimod alfa analysis, IMP761 data), a cash balance of A$68.87 million, and ongoing cost-reduction measures. It also describes the wind-down of the TACTI-004 trial following an IDMC futility recommendation, but this is a clinical development update, not a corporate transaction. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, restructuring, or capital action is disclosed; this is a standard periodic operational report.
